analogy.rationale: IKK inhibitors block the same canonical NF-kB activation step (IKBKB), so they should phenocopy the transcriptional response most closely; JNK/p38 MAPK inhibitors intersect overlapping stress/inflammatory signaling, while proteasome and calcineurin inhibitors only partially overlap. Overall the response is expected to be weak because NF-kB target genes are largely non-landmark and these cells have modest baseline NF-kB activity.
